race.comment: HIERARCHY (9) looks ready to run a big race on debut. An absolute blueblood, being by global superstar Dubawi out of former gun mare Colette, and he's won his two latest jumpouts in preparation for this. One of them was here, so he's familiar with the course being trained down this way. KOORALBYN (1) is a son of Extreme Choice who must have had some issues along the way, given he's making his debut as a 4YO, but the two trials have indicated he's got talent and he draws to get his chance to make a big first impression. SATOSHI (15) showed good improvement first-up, when beaten in a three-way photo, and that edge in fitness on some key rivals might prove crucial. ZOVOZO (4) comes through a couple of handy races, which she'll be better for, and draws to get her chance.
